user.title: Connect to your Harmony hub
user.description: Enter the hub address and the access token.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The hub rejected the saved token. Enter the new token.

hassio_confirm.title: Link the Harmony Editor add-on
hassio_confirm.description: The Harmony Editor add-on was found: {slug} at {host}. Link it so this hub gets its configuration from the add-on? The add-on only feeds the config; this integration stays the hub's only client. Only continue if this is the add-on you installed.

hub_moved.title: Hub moved?
hub_moved.description: Hub {name} announced itself at {new_host}, but it is set up at {old_host}. Anyone on your network can send such an announcement, and confirming sends this hub's access token to the new address. Only continue if you moved the hub there yourself.

reconfigure.title: Change the hub connection
reconfigure.description: Change the hub address or access token.

error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected by the hub.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the hub.
error.unsupported_version: The hub speaks an incompatible protocol version. Update the hub firmware or this integration so both use the same version.

abort.wrong_hub: The token belongs to a different hub.
abort.addon_linked: The Harmony Editor add-on is linked.
abort.addon_updated: The Harmony Editor add-on address was updated.
abort.no_hub: Set up a Harmony hub first, then restart the Harmony Editor add-on so it announces itself again.
abort.invalid_auth: The add-on refused the discovery token. Restart the add-on and try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Harmony Editor add-on.
abort.invalid_discovery: The add-on sent an unusable discovery message.
abort.not_our_addon: Only the Harmony Editor add-on can link to this integration.
abort.hub_moved_updated: The hub's new address was saved.

config_invalid.title: Harmony config from the add-on was rejected
config_invalid.description: The add-on's applied config for hub {hub} failed validation here and the previous config stays active: {error}

config_rejected.title: The hub rejected the Harmony config
config_rejected.description: Hub {hub} refused the pushed config and keeps running its previous one: {error}

bundle_schema.title: Harmony add-on and integration versions do not match
bundle_schema.description: Hub {hub}: {error}. Update the Harmony Editor add-on and the Harmony integration to matching versions; the previous config stays active.

yaml_unused.title: Upload your Harmony YAML in the Harmony Editor add-on
yaml_unused.description: Integration 0.3.0 no longer reads {path} for hub {hub}. Upload that file in the Harmony Editor add-on (import YAML, then apply). The file is untouched; delete it once imported.

ota_rolled_back.title: Hub firmware update rolled back
ota_rolled_back.description: Hub {hub} did not come up healthy after installing build {build} and went back to its previous firmware ({reason}). Nothing was lost; check the build and try again.

ota_dev_key.title: Hub firmware trusts the public dev key
ota_dev_key.description: Hub {hub} was built with the public development OTA key: anyone who can reach its WebSocket and token can install firmware on it. Install a build with your own release key.

reload_config.name: Reload config
reload_config.description: Pull the applied config from the Harmony Editor add-on now, recompile it and push it if it changed.

config_entry.name: Config entry
config_entry.description: Hub (entry id or hub id). Optional when only one hub is set up.

push_pages.name: Push pages
push_pages.description: Send the compiled remote pages and tile texts to the remotes again.

config_entry.name: Config entry
config_entry.description: Hub (entry id or hub id). Optional when only one hub is set up.

send_ir.name: Send IR
send_ir.description: Send one IR action through the hub.

config_entry.name: Config entry
config_entry.description: Hub (entry id or hub id). Optional when only one hub is set up.

ir.name: IR action
ir.description: A config-format-2 IR action, e.g. {proto: nec, addr: 4, cmd: 8}. File references are not accepted.

set_device_state.name: Set device state
set_device_state.description: Tell the hub a device was switched by hand (no IR is sent).

config_entry.name: Config entry
config_entry.description: Hub (entry id or hub id). Optional when only one hub is set up.

input.name: Input
input.description: Selected input name; empty for unknown.

install_firmware.name: Install firmware
install_firmware.description: Upload a signed hub firmware image. The hub verifies the signature itself, applies it, restarts into it and rolls back automatically if the new build does not come up healthy.

config_entry.name: Config entry
config_entry.description: Hub (entry id or hub id). Optional when only one hub is set up.

path.name: Image path
path.description: Path of the signed .img file, under config/ha_harmony/firmware or a directory in allowlist_external_dirs.

allow_dev_key.name: Allow dev key
allow_dev_key.description: Install on a hub that trusts the public dev test key (anyone can sign images for it). Leave off for a real hub.

state.nothing_applied: No config applied for this hub in the add-on

ha_device_state.message: {device} is a Home Assistant device: its state is its entity's.

not_linked.message: This hub is not linked to the Harmony Editor add-on.

no_activities.message: The hub has no activities configured.

several_hubs.message: Several hubs are configured: pass config_entry.

ota_not_signed.message: That file is not a signed Harmony firmware image (no HOTA header). Unsigned files are never sent to the hub.

ota_wrong_target.message: That image is not for the hub.

ota_truncated.message: The image is incomplete: its header says {expected} bytes but the file has {actual}. Download it again.

ota_path_not_allowed.message: {path} is not under config/ha_harmony/firmware or an allowlist_external_dirs directory.

ota_in_progress.message: A firmware update is already being uploaded to this hub.

ota_dev_key.message: This hub trusts the public dev OTA key, so any image signed with it would be accepted. Rebuild the hub with a release key, or set allow_dev_key to install anyway.

data.hold_events: Also fire an event for each hold repeat

data_description.hold_events: Off by default: a press and a release are recorded, a held key is not (it would write a database row every 0.4 s). Home Assistant key actions with repeat are not affected.
